Customers cannot empty their account. With a balance of 50, withdraw(50) raises InsufficientFunds even though they have exactly enough money.
reference_test:
import unittest

from bank import Account, InsufficientFunds


class TestWithdraw(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_withdraw_exact_balance(self):
        acc = Account('ana', 50)
        acc.withdraw(50)
        self.assertEqual(acc.balance, 0)

    def test_still_rejects_overdraft(self):
        acc = Account('ana', 50)
        with self.assertRaises(InsufficientFunds):
            acc.withdraw(51)
